Attached: 1 image

NocoDB 2026.10.0 is out! 📊 The open-source Airtable alternative adds major upgrades for project tracking and automations:

• Timeline Resource Allocation with overbooking detection
• Workflow Playback to step through past runs with filters
• Button fields now trigger automations directly

Available soon on PikaPods.

https://github.com/nocodb/nocodb/releases/tag/2026.10.0
https://pikapods.com/pods?run=nocodb

#opensource #ownyourdata
